name: Saffron Magnet Train & Goldenrod City Arrival
summary: With the Kanto League conquered, purchase a $1,000 ticket at Saffron City's central station to board the ultra-high-speed Magnet Train across Mt. Silver into Johto. Step onto the platform of Goldenrod City, the dazzling commercial heart of the region.
